english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese word for a written composition or essay.
Use this for an essay, especially a school or exam essay.

examples.english: The teacher asked me to write an essay about environmental protection.
examples.traditional: 老師叫我寫一篇關於環保嘅作文。
examples.jyutping: lou5 si1 giu3 ngo5 se2 jat1 pin1 gwaan1 jyu1 waan4 bou2 ge3 zok3 man4

examples.english: I spent the whole afternoon writing this composition.
examples.traditional: 呢篇作文我寫咗成個下午。
examples.jyutping: ni1 pin1 zok3 man4 ngo5 se2 zo2 sing4 go3 haa6 ng5
